components: Retries carry the same identity and semantically equivalent payload.
The worker checks for an existing in-progress or completed result.
The effect uses an upsert, compare-and-set, or idempotency key.
The durable outcome is associated with the stable key.
Later attempts return the recorded result without repeating the effect.
